_comment: Example settings.json. The real file lives at %AppData%\InternetMonitor\settings.json and is never checked into source control. Copy the shape below as a starting point.
_comment_endpoints: Application endpoints are entirely user-defined - nothing here is required by the application itself. The two examples below show how an organization would add its own APIs; delete them if you don't need them. Kind is Url, TcpPort or Ping; a Url endpoint may carry Headers (an API key) and an ExpectedStatusCode.
_comment_secrets: Header values, KumaPushUrl and WebhookUrl are credentials. Type them as readable text; on its first start with a readable credential the app asks whether to protect them with your Windows account, after which they are stored as 'dpapi:...' and decrypted on load. ProtectSecrets is null until you have answered, then true or false.
_comment_logging: Diagnostic logging is off by default. Levels: Off, Basic, Extended, Full. The two rotation limits have no row in Settings and are clamped (1-50 files, 1 KB-1 GB). DiagnosticLogDirectory must be a local folder; empty means the default logs folder.
_comment_kuma: Uptime Kuma push heartbeat is off by default (KumaPushUrl empty). Paste your own push-monitor URL to activate it; the interval is clamped to 60-86400 seconds.
_comment_webhook: One JSON POST when an incident opens and one when it closes. https anywhere; plain http only to an address inside your own network.
